title: Delete a tenant through the admin routes
goal: Add DELETE /admin/tenants/:id: add a remove method to TenantRegistry in src/lib/tenants.ts, call it from src/routes/admin.ts, answer 404 for an unknown tenant, and write an audit entry for the deletion like the other admin writes. A deleted tenant must no longer be accepted by POST /webhooks. Add tests in test/admin.test.ts.
acceptance: DELETE /admin/tenants/:id removes a known tenant and answers 404 for an unknown one
The deletion writes an audit entry with the tenant
POST /webhooks answers 404 for the deleted tenant
The suite stays green with new tests for the delete path
